title: Continual Image Trainer 3
description: A browser-side continual image trainer with web search, Hugging Face dataset streaming, whole-folder datasets, local video frame extraction, sequential one-image-at-a-time training, generation, persistent replay memory, and save/load checkpoints.

title: CRT Lab Pro 3
description: A full WebGL2 CRT and analog-video workstation with RGB/component/S-Video/NTSC/PAL/RF/VHS paths, phosphor and tube physics, professional scopes, guided calibration, processed recording, screen/camera input, A/B comparison, faults, presets, diagnostics, shareable setups, and offline PWA support.
